message: MQ-9B reconnaissance mission started. Primary objective is route observation and area awareness for the eastern training corridor.
EO/IR sensor check complete. Video feed stable. Image quality good.
Aircraft established on planned observation track. Weather is clear with light surface haze.
Historical activity noted near Checkpoint Delta during previous exercises. Recommend continued observation while transiting the sector.
Event: Three vehicles observed parked near Checkpoint Delta. No movement detected at this time.
Decision: Maintain observation of Checkpoint Delta for five additional minutes before continuing route scan.
Event: One vehicle departed Checkpoint Delta heading west along the service road.
Vehicle movement appears consistent with routine exercise traffic. No unusual indicators identified.
Temporary delay in chat relay from forward observer team. Voice backup remains available.
Aircraft continuing planned route. Fuel and system status nominal.
Event: Heat signature detected near Supply Point Echo. Appears stationary and partially obscured by structures.
Tasking: Capture still image of Supply Point Echo and continue passive observation.
Still image captured. Heat signature now assessed as likely generator or equipment source.
Light cloud cover expected to increase over the western sector within 30 minutes. Visibility may degrade slightly.
Chat relay restored. Ground team confirms no abnormal activity near Supply Point Echo.
Pattern update: Checkpoint Delta and Supply Point Echo both remain within expected exercise activity.
Event: Small group of personnel observed near Training Area North. Activity appears administrative.
Decision: No change to mission plan. Continue route observation and log significant deviations only.
Aircraft approaching final observation segment. Systems remain nominal.
Final segment scan complete. No priority anomalies observed.
Decision: End active reconnaissance collection and prepare mission summary. Include vehicle movement at Checkpoint Delta, Supply Point Echo heat source assessment, and temporary comms relay delay.
